description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker gemma4-26b-a4b recipe for Google's Gemma 4 26B-A4B-it (Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision 4d7ae498) served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: online FP8 quantization of the bf16 checkpoint, FP8 KV cache, safetensors loading, prefix caching, gemma4 reasoning and tool-call parsers, 262,144-token context, 8,192 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); the sequence limit is left to vLLM's default as upstream sets none. Upstream's recipe is written for two Sparks with tensor parallel 2; eugr's --solo mode runs the same command at tensor parallel 1 (the only override), which is this single-Spark recipe. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B FP8 vLLM single Spark (eugr)
